churn_resistance.rationale: Data access, configuration and API shape knowledge are each isolated behind one module with typed boundaries, so a framework or API change touches very few files. The undocumented match flag, the non-conventional server-only file naming, and the complete absence of app-owned tests (testLoc 0) are the residual churn risks.

findings.issue: Not-found title detection reads m._notFound, an underscore-prefixed internal field of RouteMatch that is typed but not documented, alongside the public m.status === 'notFound'.
findings.suggestion: Rely on the documented status ('notFound') where possible, or move 404 title handling into each route's head()/notFoundComponent so the root route doesn't need to introspect match internals.

findings.issue: fetchJson() never receives an AbortSignal, so loader cancellations (rapid navigation/preloads) don't propagate to the upstream PokeAPI requests, and in-flight responses keep running to completion.
findings.suggestion: Thread the loader's abortController signal (TanStack loaders provide one) through fetchJson to fetch(url, { signal }).

findings.issue: Server-only helpers live in pokeapi.ts without the .server.ts suffix, so keeping them out of the client bundle depends on tree-shaking rather than the compiler guarantee the Server Functions docs describe.
findings.suggestion: Rename to src/server/pokeapi.server.ts (and functions.ts -> *.functions.ts) so the Start compiler enforces the client/server boundary.

findings.issue: The card sprite URL is constructed from a hardcoded path pattern rather than the sprites.front_default URL the API already returns.
findings.suggestion: Carry front_default through the server fns (with the documented pattern as a fallback) so the card layer doesn't depend on the media layout.

findings.issue: The app ships with zero of its own tests or a test runner, so future framework upgrades (e.g. the next Start minor that removes a deprecated option) have no local regression net beyond the harness's acceptance tests.
findings.suggestion: Add a minimal Vitest run for the pure modules (format, pokeapi mappers, search validation) — they are already factored for it.

summary: This is a current-generation TanStack Start app: createServerFn().validator(), the HeadContent/head pipeline, notFound() and file-based routing are all exactly what the 1.0-stable docs prescribe, on React 19.3, Vite 8 and TypeScript 7. Dependencies are minimal and modern, with srvx standing in for a heavier Nitro deployment. The only forward-looking concerns are small: one undocumented match internal (_notFound), no AbortSignal propagation to upstream fetches, and no app-owned tests.

apis.replacement: the documented match.status === 'notFound', or per-route head()/notFoundComponent for 404 titles
